title: Front Office Executive
description:
Front Office Executive

**Location:** Ernakulam  
**Industry:** EdTech  
**Job Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are hiring a **Front Office Executive** for our EdTech company in Kozhikode. The candidate will be responsible for managing front desk activities, handling student and parent inquiries, coordinating admissions support, and ensuring a professional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage front desk operations and welcome visitors
* Handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and walk-in inquiries
* Provide course and admission information to students and parents
* Coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and daily office activities
* Maintain inquiry records, student data, and office documents
* Support the admissions and operations team
* Ensure a clean and professional reception area

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, Email, Excel)
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities
* Professional attitude and customer service mindset

Eligibility

* Any Graduate / Diploma
* Freshers and experienced candidates can apply

KPIs / Performance Metrics

* Inquiry response time
* Student follow-up completion rate
* Accuracy of records and data entry
* Visitor/student satisfaction
* Punctuality and attendance
* Support in inquiry-to-admission conversions

Preferred Candidate

* Friendly and confident personality
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Prior front office or customer support experience is an advantage

Pay: From ₹17,200.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
